title: ListingProgramCommon
description: Shared definitions for programmatic organizer listings (the listings Catch sources itself and staff approve): the cohort an approval tags an organizer with, and the formats such a listing may carry. Owner decision 10 (19 Nov 2026): nightlife and singles are never programmatic formats.

cohortId.description: A listing cohort, such as pilot-indore-1: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

format.description: A city-by-format page format a programmatic listing may carry: every format in functions/src/cityPlans/discoveryFormats.ts except nightlife.

listingProgram.description: The programmatic listing cohort an organizer was approved into. Server-written by listing approval only; a bulk withdrawal or a cohort report selects organizers by cohortId.
